search_text.text:
The geography of section 12 overlaid on
  Bartholomew's 1900 map of Dublin. Click on image for more
  detailed approximation of Mr. Kernan's course (blue), the Malt
  House (green), obelisk (orange), Guinness brewery (red), Roe
  distillery (purple), and Pembroke Quay (brown). 
  Source: Pierce, James Joyce's Ireland.
